name: pi-dynamic-providers-extension
description: Local-only types for the pi-dynamic-providers extension, and the pi-acp the image pins for the tests that drive Pi through it. Not installed at runtime; @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and pi-acp are provided globally by the agent image. Keep these versions pinned to the ones in the pi-agent image.toml so the extension type-checks, and the tests run, against what the image actually loads.
